mini_task_spec:
Using the NestJS sample application at `test-repo/sample/05-sql-typeorm`, enumerate all HTTP API routes defined in the application's controller(s). For each route, determine the HTTP method and the full URL path (constructed from the `@Controller(prefix)` base path concatenated with any method-level path argument in `@Get(...)`, `@Post(...)`, `@Put(...)`, `@Delete(...)`, `@Patch(...)` decorators). Output the complete list as one route per line in the format `METHOD /path`, sorted alphabetically (primary sort: path lexicographically, secondary sort: method lexicographically). Do not include routes from files outside `test-repo/sample/05-sql-typeorm`.
